summary.es: Plataforma empresarial integral que combina punto de venta, control de inventario transaccional y microservicios con seguridad JWT.
summary.en: Comprehensive enterprise platform combining point of sale, transactional inventory control, and microservices with JWT security.

description.es: Plataforma empresarial integral que combina punto de venta, control de inventario transaccional y microservicios con seguridad JWT.
description.en: Comprehensive enterprise platform combining point of sale, transactional inventory control, and microservices with JWT security.

impact.es: Impacto: Persistencia transaccional ACID, seguridad perimetral JWT y APIs estandarizadas para altos volúmenes de peticiones.
impact.en: Impact: ACID transactional persistence, perimeter JWT security, and standardized APIs handling high-throughput request loads.

architecture.es: Arquitectura en Capas (Controller-Service-Repository) con microservicios REST, seguridad por roles y persistencia transaccional.
architecture.en: Layered Architecture (Controller-Service-Repository) with REST microservices, role-based security, and transactional persistence.

es: Diseño de persistencia transaccional en SQL Server con integridad referencial ACID.
Seguridad perimetral mediante tokens JWT con control de expiración y roles.
Documentación completa de endpoints con Swagger / OpenAPI 3.0 y contenedorización Docker.
en: Transactional persistence design in SQL Server with ACID referential integrity.
Perimeter security using JWT tokens with expiration control and role-based permissions.
Comprehensive endpoint documentation with Swagger / OpenAPI 3.0 and Docker containerization.
